effect-quote: It seemed as though a cloak of feathers whirled across the air; birds by the hundred. They blocked a glowing jet of flames coming down and dissipated it high above. The birds circled, cawing victory, and Wiskeria began to cackle now, joining her mother’s voice.

Dying fire in the skies. The [Flamestrike]’s magic was just mage-magic; once defeated by Mavika’s magic, it became aimless fire magic, rapidly vanishing. Whorls of random fire drifting down amidst the rain.
One that lands and splashes outwards from where it strikes, rolling out thirty feet in every direction, knocking Goblins off their feet with the blastwave
The [Flamestrike] bursts off it, and she stands there, bathed in the light, smiling sadly.

holder-quote: After his eyes cleared from the flash, Niers tried one last time.
effect-quote: A flash of fire; the thing moved through it without even pausing.
